newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firm in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firm in quiet trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mostly higher on Tuesday following a firmer close in Tokyo, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 Index in London was up 7.55 points at 1443.36 by 1302 GMT, after the Nikkei 225 in Tokyo ended 0.67 percent higher helped by strong U.S. semiconductor data.
Dealers said trading was quiet although there were positive performances from Takeda and NEC.
One dealer added that the market lacked direction while another cited the Nikkei 225 remaining above the 21,000 level as significant.
"The longer we remain above the 21,000 level, the more chance the market has in gaining confidence," said a dealer at a leading international securities house.
The positive data from the U.S. Semiconductor Industry Association also contributed to the firmer tone of Japanese equities in London, a dealer said.
